points.description: States that the desiccator is used to cool the samples (bring down the temperature) safely/without the sample absorbing moisture from the surrounding air (keeps it dry / prevents moisture gain).
points.partial_credit: Give 0.75 if only says it cools the sample or only says it keeps it dry/away from moisture, without linking both.

points.description: Mentions avoiding condensation or moisture addition from the surroundings (any wording, e.g. no water vapour/humidity picked up).
points.partial_credit: Give 0.25 for a vague reference to protecting the sample from air or humidity.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the sample is cooled in the desiccator without picking up moisture (or condensation) from the air, in any wording. Give part marks if only cooling or only moisture protection is stated. Give no marks for unrelated purposes such as heating, drying in the oven, or weighing only.
